svg.title: Orthographic views of binary joint distributions
svg.desc: Each law is represented by its two signed marginal means and its correlation. The first row uses the input counts. The second squares each cell and renormalizes within each setting. The table gives the underlying counts and exact coordinates.
svg.text: Binary joint laws in three coordinates
A and B are signed outcomes. AB is their product. Leader lines identify settings at their exact projected centers.
Hypothetical squaring of the binned counts
Input counts and exact signed means
Each row has its own denominator. In the control each squared count is divided by the sum of the four squares.
